title: Infinite Zoom — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea connects
scenes.purpose: Establish one glowing copper portal (the idea) inside a dark lens world and grow its connections into a system.
visuals: Dark teal-black void with a stationary reading scrim on the left
Lens world at right: copper portal hub already showing the next world inside it
Spokes and ring connections draw out from the hub; neutral nodes pop in as each spoke arrives

beats.development: Kicker and headline 'An idea' reveal; the copper portal rim glows in.
Connections draw hub-to-node then node-to-node while 'becomes a connected system', the rule and the caption reveal.
captions: EVERY NODE IS A PORTAL TO THE NEXT WORLD

scenes.title: Through the portals
scenes.purpose: Continuous spiral camera dolly through two nested portals (x1 to x9) so each next world fills the frame at its handoff scale.
visuals: Log-spiral camera path toward the portal chain fixed point
World 2 and World 3 already exist inside each portal; deeper worlds brighten as they approach
Fixed scale ruler and SCALE readout track the camera level

beats.development: Camera pushes into the first portal; World 2 fills the lens at x3 handoff while the outer system leaves frame.
Second portal handoff to World 3 at x9, easing out into the same framing as the first world.

scenes.title: Settled system
scenes.purpose: Hold the self-similar World 3 framing with all copy legible; framing matches the connected first world for a loop.
visuals: World 3 framed exactly like World 1 inside the larger World 2 context
All copy and SCALE x9.00 readout settled

beats.development: Reading hold on the full composition.
captions: EVERY NODE IS A PORTAL TO THE NEXT WORLD

findings: Copy reveals finish by 1.25 s and stay fixed in a stationary 2D layer while the world zooms beneath, so reading is not interrupted by the camera move.
The two-level zoom takes 1.5 s with power2.inOut, so the velocity at each handoff stays continuous.
Everything is settled by 2.45 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.45-3.0 s final hold gives a settled read of the full composition and the matched loop framing.
